title: Shadow Puppetry — An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Curtain, lamp and cast system
scenes.purpose: On a moonlit shadow-theatre screen, a rod puppet raises an idea lamp. Its light casts a network of connected shadows, and a hanging sign names the idea.
visuals: Navy velvet curtain halves parting to side columns under a fixed scalloped valance
Canvas 2D silver-blue translucent screen with stationary seeded grain
Blurred, enlarged network node and edge shadows (depth 2)
Sharp near-black rod puppet with neck, shoulder and elbow pivots and control rods (depth 1)
Lamp silhouette with a warm lit filament cut-out, rays and glow
Hanging dark caption board on strings

beats.development: The closed navy curtain parts from the centre seam into side columns and reveals the screen, the ground band and the puppet holding an unlit lamp low.

The puppet's shoulder and elbow pivots raise the lamp on its rigid rod and the head tilts up. The lamp lights: a warm filament opening, drawn rays, and a screen hotspot. The figure's penumbra falls away from the lamp.

Dotted beams reach out. Node shadows travel outward from the lamp and grow with their distance from it, and connecting edges draw them into one system. The caption board drops on strings and settles, and its text fades in only after the board has landed.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

beats.development: The whole composition holds still for reading.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

findings: The curtain wipe is the opening attention change. The lamp raise and lighting are the primary action, and the shadow cast and sign drop overlap as one resolving beat.
All motion settles by 2.27 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
The caption appears only after its board is complete.
justifiedHolds: A 0.73 s final hold gives the 6-word caption and the finished network a still read inside the 3-second preview.

notes: No preview recipe is defined in STYLE.json. The refresh follows the BACKGROUND_REVIEW source-frame lessons with a moonlit blue palette.
Built with Canvas 2D, SVG and GSAP only. Blender was not used.
